title: palicourea siccorubra
intro: Palicourea siccorubra, commonly known as Brazil wood, is a plant species in the family Rubiaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from fever, inflammation, and pain. The health benefits of Palicourea siccorubra include its use as an anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimalarial agent, attributed to its therapeutic actions such as analgesia and antipyretic activity. The bioactive constituents of Palicourea siccorubra include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
